attrs.citation: Binchi Zhang, Zihan Chen, Cong Shen & Jundong Li, "Verification of Machine Unlearning is Fragile", ICML 2024 (arXiv 2408.00929)
hypotheses: the verifier is limited to the strategies in the two surveyed families
the provider is adversarial rather than merely careless
attrs.note: VERIFIED 2026-08-24 — the paper exists, is ICML 2024, and its abstract says what is attributed to it here. Taken for exactly one purpose: it bounds GPT-5.6's EC-9. `supersede` is dischargeable for an artifact you can delete and inspect; it is not dischargeable for the weights component of a support set, because the check that would confirm it is defeatable by the party being checked.
attrs.result: Two adversarial unlearning processes are constructed, each targeting one of the two families of existing unlearning-verification strategy. A dishonest model provider can pass verification while secretly retaining the information that was supposed to be unlearned.
